primaryChecks.text: For he built the House of the Forest of Lebanon. Its length was one hundred cubits, its width fifty cubits, and its height thirty cubits, on four rows of cedar pillars, with cedar beams on the pillars.
primaryChecks.previousContext: Solomon was building his own house thirteen years, and he finished all his house.
primaryChecks.nextContext: It was covered with cedar above over the forty-five beams that were on the pillars, fifteen in a row.

primaryChecks.text: He made three hundred shields of beaten gold; three minas of gold went to one shield; and the king put them in the House of the Forest of Lebanon.
primaryChecks.previousContext: King Solomon made two hundred bucklers of beaten gold; six hundred shekels of gold went to one buckler.
primaryChecks.nextContext: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with the finest gold.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 本文に地名が明記される。用例の地理的意味はprofile本文で限定した。

primaryChecks.text: All King Solomon’s drinking vessels were of gold, and all the vessels of the House of the Forest of Lebanon were of pure gold. None were of silver, because it was considered of little value in the days of Solomon.
primaryChecks.previousContext: Twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other on the six steps. Nothing like it was made in any kingdom.
primaryChecks.nextContext: For the king had a fleet of ships of Tarshish at sea with Hiram’s fleet. Once every three years the fleet of Tarshish came bringing gold, silver, ivory, apes, and peacocks.
